rationale: Norway heavy favorites by Elo (~260-pt gap), squad value (Haaland/Odegaard vs sub-EUR50m Iraq), form (8/8 WCQ, +32 GD) and market (~1.21 dec, ~82% Kalshi). Prior already encodes this, so strength kept = prior_strength; only small evidence-based adjustments applied: Norway atk +5% / def -5% (elite scoring + stingy form), Iraq atk -5% (blunt vs quality) offset by def -3% (Arnold's disciplined low block). Neutral venue -> no host edge. Lambdas ~ Norway 1.97 / Iraq 0.55, total ~2.5, consistent with all benchmarks.
